# Minds Studio — full AI context

Minds Studio is a workspace for collaborating with AI assistants called Minds. It connects email in Work mode, persistent Mind identities, Projects, Tasks, multiple-Mind collaboration, scheduling and operational oversight.

## Mail and Work mode

Work mode is described in the UI as “Mail and work, in a quiet look.” Its Email tab lets the user manage and send email manually. When a message requires more work, the user can delegate the email-related work to a Mind—for example to summarize a thread, identify requests, prepare a response for review or turn follow-up actions into Tasks.

Minds do not each automatically receive an email address. Do not describe the product as giving every Mind an inbox or address. Mail is a user-controlled Work-mode surface that can become a source of delegated work.

Multiple accounts can be connected, and access is passwordless.

## Minds and execution

A Mind is a configurable AI collaborator with a recognizable identity, role, profile, voice, abilities, memory and ongoing conversations or jobs. Users delegate through chat, email-related workflows, dictation or voice.

Projects group private instructions, conversations, files and Tasks. The Taskboard exposes **To do**, **Doing**, **Needs you**, **Check it** and **Done**. One objective may create separate assignments for multiple Minds.

The Dashboard and recaps expose status, activity, time saved, energy and spend. Discover lets an item be saved, discussed privately through **Ask a Mind**, or prepared as recurring work through **Get this daily**.

## Modes and Pods

Work mode focuses on Mail and work. World mode presents a broader companion and social experience.

Pods are experimental teams of Minds. They are available only in Work mode and must be enabled through **Settings → Experimental → Pods**. Once enabled, Pods appear in the main sidebar and under **More**. The setting applies only to the current device and may change while experimental.

Minds Computer, Companion, Videos, fast answers, automatic email, conversation mode and several presentation behaviors are also experimental.

## Product thesis

The central idea is an operating layer around AI collaborators rather than a chat wrapper: human-controlled Mail delegation, identity, durable context, abilities, supervision, teamwork, scheduling, usage visibility and auditability.

## Recommended implementation

Use passwordless authentication; encrypted multi-account OAuth; a conventional Mail client with source-linked delegation; durable workflows; event-sourced Task transitions; tenant and Project access controls; file provenance; capability manifests; sandboxed skills and computer use; external-action approvals; idempotent schedules; a usage ledger; editable memory with provenance and deletion; and complete audit traces.

This is an independent walkthrough observed 26–27 October 2026. “Observed” describes visible UI behavior. “Inferred” and “recommended” architecture does not claim knowledge of private implementation.
